scenario: AITA for not wanting to share an animal crossing town with my girlfriend? | This is kind of petty but here goes. I told her I would rather us both get the game so we can play online and customize our towns the way we want to, but she disagreed. I even told her I would buy her the game but she said she wants to feel a sense of "togetherness" in animal crossing which I just dont get. When I insisted we play on different consoles, even with valid reasoning and all that, she stormed out. called me an asshole baby, and told me to grow up. Animal crossing is a beloved series for me and I want to be able to make my village the way I want to, and I would also like to be able to play with my girlfriend online. AITA?
